signals_info.description: Whether the vehicle is in automatic or assisted parking mode.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition parking_mode == 1 shall cease to be true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，parking_mode == 1 这一条件应刚停止成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The vehicle shall exit automatic or assisted parking mode at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 车辆应在未来某个时刻退出自动或辅助泊车模式。
